newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea to lower tariffs on cement imports.
newsitem.headline: South Korea to lower tariffs on cement imports.

text.p: South Korea will lower tariffs on cement imports to one percent from five percent during the first half of 1997 to help ease expected domestic shortages this year, a trade ministry statement said on Tuesday.
The ministry expects about three million tonnes of cement to be imported during the first half, a ministry official said.
Imports for 1997 are forecast at four million tonnes, compared with 3.4 million tonnes imported last year, he said.
South Korean cement makers are capable of producing a combined 59 million tonnes of cement per year, while domestic demand this year is expected to be between 62 and 63 million tonnes, he added.
